skeleton.contract: Canonical18 names/order/parents; tennis-v7 T-pose translations and inverse binds. Embedded animations are authored for this bind.

sounds.label: Line judge: out cue
sounds.description: Sharp descending abstract breathy call; non-speech, no words or human recording.

sounds.label: Line judge: good cue
sounds.description: Softer gently rising abstract breathy call; non-speech, no words or human recording.

sounds.label: Tennis ball rolling on hard court
sounds.description: Short dry felt friction and decelerating court grain; no bounce or voice.

sounds.label: Soft applause
sounds.description: Eight restrained, irregular hand claps with a compact quiet tail; no crowd speech.

preview.runtime: Local Three.js r160; no CDN, network, or build step required when served over HTTP.

runtimeContract.childScale: Apply uniformScale to the complete actor container, including skeleton and embedded Ball. Body GLBs share one bind; children are scaled adaptations of the stylized tennis-v7 humans.
runtimeContract.rootMotion: Baked into Root. kid_run_collect travels +2.4m; kid_return turns, travels -2.4m, and faces front again. Apply container scale once; do not add duplicate motion. When chaining after collect, place the return container at the previous root endpoint.
runtimeContract.playback: Only idle/seated clips loop. Gestures and locomotion hold their final frame. Use the declared idle for entry/exit blends; chair_idle stands on court, other chair clips use the high chair.
runtimeContract.ball: Ball is a separate scene-root mesh with independent baked translations, not parented to a hand. Hand IK follows authored ball paths at build time. Hidden in non-ball clips via scale=0. Radius before container scaling: 0.0335m.
runtimeContract.audio: Trigger animation extras.events sound IDs once when crossing cue time; enable audio after user interaction. No speech.
